basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 29-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I recently discovered Reddit and I'm loving the vibrant communities here, especially those related to my favorite childhood shows like Danny Phantom. When I'm not designing or browsing Reddit, I enjoy playing pickup hockey games, experimenting with indoor gardening, and exploring the local food scene with my partner. I'm usually online in the evenings, Pacific Time. I'm always on the lookout for new design trends and love sharing tips with fellow creatives.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for over 7 years. My expertise lies in digital illustration and branding. I stay updated through online courses and design communities. I'm also self-taught in organic gardening, which is becoming a new passion of mine.
